title: What Is Technical Writing?
skills: define technical writing and identify its common purposes
distinguish technical writing from other forms of informational writing
analyze how audience and purpose shape technical communication
recognize the importance of clarity, precision, and organization in technical texts
alignment_note: Introduces technical writing as a form of clear, precise, audience-focused communication used to explain information, processes, and procedures. Supports informational writing, expository structure, audience awareness, purpose, organization, and practical communication across high school English courses.
